description: Qwen3-0.6B batch-1 decode after an 8192-token prompt. TensorRT with Inductor's kernels: the session recipe, the step-graph control, the kernels.inductor variants on top of the session recipe, and the strongest Inductor configuration. The 29-engine region variants (trt-hybrid-attention, trt-hybrid-attention-math) have run at one of two launch-gap levels per process with identical kernels and graphs: judge them over several rounds

notes.trt-session: The recipe the published agent session selected. --session DIR replaces it with the recipe the session in DIR selected
notes.trt-session-step-graph: Control: the session recipe captured as one whole-step CUDA graph (runtime.step_graph), the capture the region variants need
notes.trt-hybrid-attention-flex: kernels.inductor=attention-flex: Inductor's generated flex-decoding kernels (a split-KV template and two combine reductions) hosted in the engine as fused_kernel plugins, no engine boundary, under the session's per-engine CUDA graphs
notes.trt-hybrid-attention-flex-step-graph: attention-flex under the whole-step CUDA graph (compare with trt-session-step-graph)
notes.trt-hybrid-lm-head: The final RMSNorm and lm_head as one execute_in_torch(backend='inductor') region (one engine boundary); requires the step graph
notes.trt-hybrid-attention: Every layer's decode attention as an Inductor region running flex-decoding through the opaque custom operator qwen3_regions::flex_decode (28 regions, 29 engines, 56 boundaries); requires the step graph
notes.trt-hybrid-attention-math: The same 28 regions with plain attention math compiled by Inductor (QK^T matmul, masked FP32 softmax over FP16 scores, PV matmul); requires the step graph
